run_genblenddna: run the genblenddna script to generate BlenderSceneGen.h and BlenderScene.cpp from BlenderScene.h
parse_blender_structs: parse struct definitions from BlenderScene.h using regex to extract DNA structure data
extract_enums: extract enum definitions from BlenderScene.h and collect them for type casting
generate_convert_decls: generate Structure::Convert<T> template declarations for all supported Blender DNA structures
generate_register_converters: generate DNA::RegisterConverters code that maps structure names to their converter functions
